canonical_project: SDAIA Hexagon / Salboukh Digital Data Center
owner: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)
notes: SPA announced foundation stone for the Riyadh Hexagon government data center with 480 MW total capacity; AJi identifies the Salboukh Digital Data Center for SDAIA on a 2,800,000 sqm site with 30 MW initial IT capacity. Division assignment is based on Salbukh/Salboukh being mapped in the Huraymila area; public sources describe the facility generally as Riyadh/Salbukh.
